<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,>- Guest Book -
～ Please write about your travels! ～ <C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Entry #1  |  Weather: cloudy
What a beautiful city! I should
have brought my family along!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Entry #2  |  Weather: cloudy
Toadsworth is driving me up a wall!
But I finally got to sleep in for once!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Entry #3  |  Weather: clear
I've never taken a trip alone before.
I hope something exciting happens!<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Entry #4  |  Weather: clear
Hooray! First day of
our hooneymoon!<C:0003,0001,>
